send.name: Send to people
send.description: Notify people through the Companion apps they are signed in to, selected by whether they are home and by device type.

who.name: Who
who.description: home, away (any state other than home), all, or person entity IDs.

fallback.name: Fallback
fallback.description: Who to notify instead when 'who' reaches no devices (e.g. nobody is home). No default: if omitted, nothing is sent in that case.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Device types to notify: phone, tablet, computer, other. Default: every type (or the 'devices' setting in configuration.yaml). Android always counts as phone.

data.name: Data
data.description: Passed through to the Companion app (actions, tag, group, push options).

targets.name: Show targets
targets.description: Return the people and notify actions 'who' resolves to, without sending anything.
